verdict.rationale: dltHub documents run-level observability: monitoring pipeline health, inspecting logs, and diagnosing failures via the CLI and Web UI. It also covers scheduling and observing runs, with every run logged. That lets an engineer infer when data last landed, but nothing describes per-table freshness or cadence-based alerting. missing for 10: per-destination-table freshness indicators, alerts or notifications when a pipeline misses its expected schedule, SLA/cadence configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
